classification.difficultyReason: Identify exposed surfaces, exclude internal joins and calculate missing slant heights for composite solids.

content.prompt: Calculate the surface area of these composite solids. Round to the nearest whole.

spec.description: Upright cylinder topped by a hemisphere; dashed rear join and bottom arcs, solid silhouette and front arcs. Ordinary source blue outlines become black.
spec.mathematics: Common radius 4 m, marked from bottom centre to rim; cylinder height 2 m. Bottom circular face is exposed; joining circle is internal.

answer.worked:
The joining circle is internal; include the bottom face.
$$\begin{align*}
A_{\text{hemisphere}}&=2\pi(4)^2=32\pi\\
A_{\text{cylinder side}}&=2\pi(4)(2)=16\pi\\
A_{\text{bottom}}&=\pi(4)^2=16\pi\\
A_{\text{total}}&=32\pi+16\pi+16\pi\\
A_{\text{total}}&=64\pi\approx201\text{ m}^2
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Hemisphere above an inverted cone. A centre dot, red dashed radius and leader distinguish radius from the labelled cone slant height. Ordinary outlines are black.
spec.mathematics: Common radius 0.7 cm and cone slant height 1.3 cm; circular join excluded. Cone silhouette meets the projected rim at tangent points.

answer.worked:
Exclude the internal circular join.
$$\begin{align*}
A_{\text{hemisphere}}&=2\pi(0.7)^2=0.98\pi\\
A_{\text{cone side}}&=\pi(0.7)(1.3)=0.91\pi\\
A_{\text{total}}&=0.98\pi+0.91\pi\\
A_{\text{total}}&=1.89\pi\approx6\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal capsule with circular joins, solid front arcs and dashed rear arcs; separate diameter and middle-section length dimensions.
spec.mathematics: Diameter 11.8 cm; cylinder length 6.7 cm, excluding hemispherical ends. The two joins are internal.

answer.worked:
The two hemispheres form one sphere. Exclude both internal circular joins.
$$\begin{align*}
r&=11.8\div2=5.9\text{ cm}\\
A_{\text{hemispheres}}&=2\times2\pi(5.9)^2=139.24\pi\\
A_{\text{cylinder side}}&=2\pi(5.9)(6.7)=79.06\pi\\
A_{\text{total}}&=139.24\pi+79.06\pi\\
A_{\text{total}}&=218.3\pi\approx686\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal cylinder joined to a right-pointing cone, with exposed left circular face, dashed rear joining arc and tip extension for the axial dimension.
spec.mathematics: Diameter 12 cm; cylinder length 14 cm; cone perpendicular height 10 cm. Cone tangents are derived from its projected elliptical rim. Join excluded.

answer.worked:
Include the left circular face and exclude the internal join.
$$\begin{align*}
r&=12\div2=6\text{ cm}\\
l^2&=6^2+10^2=136\\
l&=\sqrt{136}\text{ cm}\\
A_{\text{cone side}}&=\pi(6)\sqrt{136}\\
A_{\text{cylinder side}}&=2\pi(6)(14)=168\pi\\
A_{\text{left face}}&=\pi(6)^2=36\pi\\
A_{\text{total}}&=6\pi\sqrt{136}+168\pi+36\pi\\
A_{\text{total}}&\approx861\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upright cylinder with conical roof, exposed bottom face, dashed rear rim arcs and separate vertical height dimensions.
spec.mathematics: Diameter 5 m, cylinder height 3 m and cone perpendicular height 3 m. Cone tangents meet the projected joining rim; the join is internal.

answer.worked:
Include the bottom circular face and exclude the internal join.
$$\begin{align*}
r&=5\div2=2.5\text{ m}\\
l^2&=2.5^2+3^2=15.25\\
l&=\sqrt{15.25}\text{ m}\\
A_{\text{cone side}}&=\pi(2.5)\sqrt{15.25}\\
A_{\text{cylinder side}}&=2\pi(2.5)(3)=15\pi\\
A_{\text{bottom}}&=\pi(2.5)^2=6.25\pi\\
A_{\text{total}}&=2.5\pi\sqrt{15.25}+15\pi+6.25\pi\\
A_{\text{total}}&\approx97\text{ m}^2
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Explicit rectangular prism and centred pyramid roof model, viewed from the front-left. Front and left edges are visible; rear prism edges and apex-to-rear-right-corner edge are dashed. Labels use non-drawing paths.
spec.mathematics: Base 7 m by 4 m, prism height 3 m and roof perpendicular height 5 m. Roof height dimension spans the apex and its centre projection on the joining plane. Shared rectangle is internal.

answer.worked:
Exclude the rectangle where the pyramid joins the prism. Include the bottom rectangle.

For triangular faces with base $4\text{ m}$:
$$\begin{align*}
l_4^2&=5^2+(7\div2)^2=37.25\\
l_4&=\sqrt{37.25}\text{ m}
\end{align*}$$
For triangular faces with base $7\text{ m}$:
$$\begin{align*}
l_7^2&=5^2+(4\div2)^2=29\\
l_7&=\sqrt{29}\text{ m}
\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}
A_{\text{roof}}&=2\left(\frac{4\sqrt{37.25}}{2}\right)+2\left(\frac{7\sqrt{29}}{2}\right)\\
A_{\text{prism sides}}&=2(3)(4)+2(3)(7)=66\\
A_{\text{bottom}}&=4(7)=28\\
A_{\text{total}}&=4\sqrt{37.25}+7\sqrt{29}+66+28\\
A_{\text{total}}&\approx156\text{ m}^2
\end{align*}$$
